title: mobile
description:
LingoBites mobile (React Native). Repo: git@github.com:thnha/LingoBites-App.git, default branch `main`.

Workspace context already defines the shared rules R1–R4, scope discipline, engineering practices, environment prerequisites, and the clarification format. This project adds:

- R5 No iOS simulator/Metro on the requester's machine by default. If device verification is mandatory: dedicated simulator by UDID (delete when done), port other than 8081, batched into milestone QA.
- Architecture reference: `docs/architecture/module-boundaries.md` (AD-004), enforced by `yarn lint:boundaries`. Keep them in sync with any structural change.
